articleSummary: As of July 1, 2026, Brazil's dengue situation reveals significant regional disparities. articleHeadline: Dengue in India: Challenges in prevention and control persist
articleSummary: Dengue continues to pose a significant health threat in India, with year-round cases reported in urban centers like Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru. Factors such as erratic rainfall, rising temperatures, and inadequate sanitation contribute to the proliferation of the dengue vector. Recent data from Gurugram reveals dengue mosquito larvae found at 227 locations, prompting health teams to conduct extensive surveillance and vector control measures. In Uttar Pradesh, a decrease in dengue and malaria cases has been noted, yet public engagement in prevention remains crucial. Coimbatore reports low active cases, while Ahmedabad's municipal health data shows only 12 dengue cases in June.
